visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male creator with purple-rimmed glasses stands in a brightly lit closet area, surrounded by shelves of luxury handbags. He wears a pink fleece pajama set with a cartoon dog. He gestures with both hands as large Chinese characters appear over him. (2) He transitions to showing individual clothing items: a striped dress shirt on a hanger, a striped tie, a cream knit vest with green accents, and white socks. He holds these up to the camera while continuing his narration in front of the wardrobe. (3) A series of photos flash on screen, showing him and a male friend in school-style uniforms at a pink-themed event venue. The background features Ferris wheel graphics, balloons, and decorative stage elements. (4) He is seated at a table indoors with his male friend, both holding silver supplement packets. They interact with the product, tearing them open and consuming the contents while smiling and talking directly to the lens. (5) A woman in a tan school blazer and plaid mini-skirt walks and spins in the event space. The setting is elaborately decorated with a carousel horse, pink drapes, and soft studio-style lighting. She poses with a plaid umbrella in the final shots.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male voice speaks excitedly in Mandarin over a light synth-pop background. The tone is friendly and welcoming as he describes his upcoming plans. (2) A sharp transition 'whoosh' SFX occurs as the scene cuts to the clothing display. The music tempo picks up with a steady electronic beat. (3) The sound of a camera shutter clicking is heard as photos are shown. Female Japanese vocals enter the BGM mix, creating a lively anime-inspired atmosphere. (4) A clear 'crinkle' and 'tear' SFX of a plastic packet being opened triggers a shift in dialogue. Two male voices discuss the product's taste with high arousal and positive sentiment. (5) A distinct 'pop' sound effect accompanies a variety text overlay on screen. A woman's voice joins the conversation, laughing loudly amidst background crowd murmurs. (6) The music swells into a final upbeat chorus as the scene moves to a fashion walk-through at the event venue, mixed with cheering and ambient hall reverb.
